title: Which country speaks it officially: Oceania
intro: Find a country in Oceania that uses each language officially.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Hiri Motu as an official language?
questions.explain: Hiri Motu is an official language of Papua New Guinea.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has French as an official language?
questions.explain: French is an official language of Vanuatu.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Palauan as an official language?
questions.explain: Palauan is an official language of Palau.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Tok Pisin as an official language?
questions.explain: Tok Pisin is an official language of Papua New Guinea.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Marshallese as an official language?
questions.explain: Marshallese is an official language of Marshall Islands.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has English as an official language?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Kiribati.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Tuvalu as an official language?
questions.explain: Tuvalu is an official language of Tuvalu.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries has Samoan as an official language?
questions.explain: Samoan is an official language of Samoa.
